Talent0_2Ability.name: Covert Tactics
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: At start of action, applies <buf ID=4011502>[Appointed]</buf> to the farthest <color=#F74848>1</color> other teammate without <buf ID=4011502>[Appointed]</buf>, lasting for <color=#F74848>3</color> turns. A maximum of <color=#F74848>3</color> <buf ID=4011502>[Appointed]</buf> effects can exist simultaneously.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Covert Tactics
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
At the start of battle and action, applies <buf ID=4011502>[Appointed]</buf> to the farthest <color=#F74848>1</color> other teammate without <buf ID=4011502>[Appointed]</buf>, lasting for <color=#F74848>3</color> turns. A maximum of <color=#F74848>3</color> <buf ID=4011502>[Appointed]</buf> effects can exist simultaneously.
For each <color=#F74848>1</color> ally on the battlefield with <buf ID=4011502>[Appointed]</buf>, DMG increases by <color=#F74848>7.5%</color>, up to a maximum of <color=#F74848>22.5%</color>.

400001.name: Strategic Strike 1
400001.SpecificEffects: When a tactical weapon runs out of Ammo, triggers <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf>. This process takes <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

401102.name: Link
401102.SpecificEffects: Allies with <buf ID=4011502>[Appointed]</buf> gain DMG <color=#F74848>+5%</color> and DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-5%</color>.

401103.name: Bide Time
401103.describe: Fully reloads all Cutter Ammo. Self and allies with <buf ID=4011502>[Appointed]</buf> gain <buf ID=7100104>[Hit Rate UP II]</buf> for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. Can continue action with remaining Movement.

401104.name: Formation Protocol
401104.describe: Selects <color=#F74848>1</color> other ally within range, consuming <color=#F74848>1</color> Cutter Ammo to apply <buf ID=4011043>[BIT - Bulwark Mode]</buf> or <buf ID=4011041>[BIT - Assault Mode]</buf> to them.

401105.name: Hidden Arrow
401105.SpecificEffects: When an ally possessing <buf ID=4011502>[Appointed]</buf> is attacked and drawn into combat, can use <color=#F74848>2</color> Cutters to launch a <buf ID=900061>[Link Retaliation]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.5x</color> DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times. Can trigger up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

401106.name: Delayed Engagement
401106.describe: Uses a Cutter to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> DMG <color=#F74848>4</color> times, and inflicts <buf ID=4011061>[Delayed Spray]</buf> on the target.

401107.name: Decoy Shell
401107.SpecificEffects: When any part suffers overdamage and there is another ally on the battlefield with <buf ID=4011502>[Appointed]</buf>, triggers <buf ID=900003>[Guts]</buf>, locking at <color=#F74848>1</color> HP. After triggering this effect, immediately removes <color=#F74848>1</color> <buf ID=4011502>[Appointed]</buf> effect.

401108.name: Eventide Cage
401108.describe: Consumes <color=#F74848>2</color> rounds of Cutter Ammo. Uses a Cutter to attack all targets within the selected <range type=2>3-tile area</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>1.6x</color> AoE DMG, and applies <terrian ID=4011081 /> to the tile hit, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

400031.name: Indiscriminate 1
400031.SpecificEffects: After the first attack with a Tactical Weapon each turn, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can trigger, with Final DMG <color=#F74848>-30%</color>. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

400033.name: Strategic Strike 4
400033.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf> is complete, restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

400034.name: Indiscriminate 2
400034.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Tactical Weapon for the first time each turn, for every <color=#F74848>1</color> AP cost, DMG <color=#F74848>+4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

400035.name: Indiscriminate 3
400035.SpecificEffects: When triggering [Indiscriminate 1]'s <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> effect, this unit can move using any remaining Movement.

400036.name: Indiscriminate 4
400036.SpecificEffects: When triggering [Indiscriminate 1]'s <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> effect, Final Damage is not reduced.

401141.name: Victory from Afar 1
401141.SpecificEffects: For the first <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> each action, the AP cost of attack skills or <skill mainSkill=401104>[Formation Protocol]</skill> is reduced by <color=#F74848>1</color>, down to a minimum cost of <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

400043.name: Power Innovation 3
400043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat. Can trigger up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

401144.name: Victory from Afar 2
401144.SpecificEffects: When a teammate possessing <buf ID=4011502>[Appointed]</buf> destroys a target part, [Colin] recovers <color=#F74848>1</color> Cutter Ammo. Can trigger up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

401145.name: Victory from Afar 3
401145.SpecificEffects: When a teammate with <buf ID=4011502>[Appointed]</buf> destroys an enemy unit, [Colin] recovers <color=#F74848>1</color> AP. Can trigger up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

401146.name: Victory from Afar 4
401146.SpecificEffects: For each <color=#F74848>1</color> ally on the battlefield possessing <buf ID=4011502>[Appointed]</buf>, Cutter Hits <color=#F74848>+1</color>, up to a maximum of <color=#F74848>+3</color>.

hiddenSkills.name: Proxy Strike
hiddenSkills.describe: Uses a Cutter to attack all targets within the selected <color=#F74848>2</color>-tile range, dealing <color=#F74848>1.2x</color> AoE DMG.

Introduction: An enforcer of the Dawnstar League's High Council, a seasoned operative with deep experience in special ops and intelligence, slick and hard to read.
